name: contract-lifecycle-advisor
description: Handle contract management-system design, negotiation support, and performance-stage dispute resolution (scenarios C1/C2/C7/C8). Use this skill to design a contract-management architecture (department roles, approval-authority matrix) and full-lifecycle management system; to build negotiation strategy and a roadmap with legal/commercial dual analysis; and to handle non-litigation emergency response to performance disputes (evidence consolidation, liability assessment, demand letters).
